## Checklist

Before submitting:

- [ ] I checked that this proposal is related to this repository.
- [ ] I searched for an existing issue describing the same or a very similar idea.
- [ ] I explained the problem or opportunity, not only the desired implementation.
- [ ] I separated verified facts from assumptions when applicable.
- [ ] I did not claim tests or evidence that do not exist.
- [ ] I removed secrets, tokens and private information.
